prompt.garment: a regular fit t-shirt in 240gsm micro-ripple textured knit (52% cotton / 48% polyester), {COR}, the entire surface covered in very fine horizontal micro-ridges about 1–2 mm apart, alternating tiny raised ribs and flat bands like a miniature ottoman, running straight across the chest, back and sleeves; from a distance it reads almost as a smooth solid knit, up close the dense horizontal lines are clearly visible; fully matte, set-in shoulders, short sleeves ending mid-bicep with a turned double-stitched hem, medium-width smooth crew-neck band with a single topstitch line, straight double-stitched hem at the hip, fully opaque
prompt.colors: PRT/MAR (deep blue-black — fotos #1–3), MRR (dark chocolate brown — #4–7), OFF (off-white — #8–10), AZL (soft periwinkle lavender blue — #11–13), VRD (muted gray-olive green — #14–15); CZA, BGE — confirmar
prompt.behavior: Fabric and construction: medium-weight 240gsm micro-textured knit — denser and more substantial than plain jersey, with a clean regular drape that skims the torso without clinging. The horizontal micro-ridges create a fine striation that the soft light turns into subtle depth: a delicate gradient of tiny parallel shadow lines, strongest on the shoulder curve and the sides of the torso where the surface turns away from the light, almost invisible on the flat center front. Matte, no sheen — a luminous flat look, not shine. On off-white and light colors the lines read as a faint tonal ribbing; on black and dark brown they appear only as a soft grain. Smooth clean collar band with a topstitch; reinforced seams; turned double-stitched sleeve and bottom hems; anti-torsion finish keeping the ridges perfectly horizontal and level across the body. Movement: the ridges bend smoothly with the fabric — where the arm bends or the hand pulls the sleeve, the lines curve and compress into soft rounded folds rather than sharp wrinkles.
prompt.fit: Fit on the model (size M on a 1.84 m, 84 kg man): body length 72 cm ending at the hip, chest width 54 cm giving 2–4 cm of relaxed ease, shoulder width 46 cm with the shoulder seam sitting exactly on the shoulder point, sleeve length 18 cm ending mid-bicep. Little stretch: clean regular silhouette, the horizontal lines staying level across the chest.
